name: Minazuki Meika
source:
#SuperSparkly #TotallyHappy #Keyboardist
"If you don't follow Meika, it's a shadowban for life ~ ♡"

A bright and glamorous trendsetter, who carries up to at least four smartphones at all times, posting on numerous different accounts. She always goes all in on her efforts, in order to ensure she's presenting herself in the most dazzling light, at all times. 
Inferiority Complex: ???
Account: ???

[Translated from [url=https://hanoura-maze.com/]Official Site[/url]]
